svg.title: Maktau: daily GPP, Reco and gap-filled NEE (g C m-2 d-1), air temperature, soil water content and precipitation from 2018-12-18 to 2024-09-03, with the recorded management events.
svg.desc: Four panels on one date axis (local time, UTC+3) from 2018-12-18 to 2024-09-03. 1902 days with gap-filled NEE; 960 days with a measured fraction of NEE below 10 % are drawn lighter. Daily GPP from 0.0 to 10.8, Reco from 0.1 to 5.8 and NEE from −5.6 to 2.5 g C m-2 d-1 (NEE < 0 = uptake). 3 recorded events in the period (2 harvest, 1 sowing), drawn as vertical lines with a type label above panel (a). Largest change of daily GPP near each event: sowing 2019-04-12: GPP rise after sowing on 2019-05-20 (+38 d, not clear); harvest 2019-08-13: GPP drop on 2019-08-18 (+5 d, not clear); harvest 2020-07-30: GPP drop on 2020-07-20 (−10 d, clear). Grey bands: 12 months with a precipitation sum above 50 mm: 2019-04, 2019-05, 2019-10, 2019-11, 2019-12, 2020-03, 2020-04, 2021-03, 2021-04, 2022-11, 2023-11, 2024-04.
